title: Light Truck Drivers
description: Drive a light vehicle, such as a truck or van, with a capacity of less than 26,001 pounds Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), primarily to pick up merchandise or packages from a distribution center and deliver. May load and unload vehicle.

tasks.text: Obey traffic laws and follow established traffic and transportation procedures.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI can guide safety procedures but human executes driving

dwas.name: Follow safety procedures for vehicle operation.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Report any mechanical problems encountered with vehicles.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reporting malfunctions is structured information relay

dwas.name: Report vehicle or equipment malfunctions.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Verify the contents of inventory loads against shipping papers.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Spec verification against references, human confirms edge cases

tasks.text: Inspect and maintain vehicle supplies and equipment, such as gas, oil, water, tires, lights, or brakes, to ensure that vehicles are in proper working condition.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Vehicle inspection is physical on-site work

dwas.name: Maintain vehicles in good working condition.

tasks.text: Read maps and follow written or verbal geographic directions.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Map route reading strong, real-world routing human

dwas.name: Receive information or instructions for performing work assignments.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Load and unload trucks, vans, or automobiles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lifting and loading of shipments

tasks.text: Present bills and receipts and collect payments for goods delivered or loaded.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Collecting fares physically from customers

dwas.name: Collect fares or payment from customers.

tasks.text: Maintain records, such as vehicle logs, records of cargo, or billing statements, in accordance with regulations.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Log delivery details into structured records

dwas.name: Record details of deliveries or shipments.

tasks.text: Drive vehicles with capacities under three tons to transport materials to and from specified destinations, such as railroad stations, plants, residences, offices, or within industrial yards.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on vehicle and equipment operation

dwas.name: Operate vehicles or material-moving equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Turn in receipts and money received from deliveries.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Billing and payment processing largely automated

tasks.text: Use and maintain the tools or equipment found on commercial vehicles, such as weighing or measuring devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of machinery

tasks.text: Report delays, accidents, or other traffic and transportation situations to bases or other vehicles, using telephones or mobile two-way radios.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Emergency notification needs live accountable delivery

dwas.name: Notify others of emergencies, problems, or hazards.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Perform emergency repairs, such as changing tires or installing light bulbs, fuses, tire chains, or spark plugs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical vehicle maintenance work

dwas.name: Maintain vehicles in good working condition.
